claim: NCENT is the motion-object segment count, 12. (decimal) — the millipede occupies 12 of the 16 motion-object slots (MOBJ* are .BLKB 16.).
MOBJC (the per-slot COLOR byte) is the head/body/vacant discriminator, NOT a bit of MOBJP — unlike Centipede. A slot with MOBJC 0 is empty; MOTION skips it (BEQ 5$).
A slot is a millipede SEGMENT (head or body) iff its picture byte MOBJP < 8 — MOTION filters to segments with CMP I,08 / BCC (other critters use pictures >= 8).
CENTPC sets the head's initial picture to 0x03 (STA MOBJP ;HEAD PICTURE). MOBJP is the leg-animation frame index, cycled 0-7 by MOTION.
CENTPC sets the head COLOR to 0x39 (STA MOBJC ;SET COLOR FOR HEAD) — the value MOTION later tests to recognise a non-poisoned head (CMP I,39).
CENTPC sets each BODY segment's COLOR to 0x3D (STA MOBJC ;SET COLOR FOR BODY) — MOTION tests CMP I,3D to recognise a body.
MOTION marks a head POISONED by testing MOBJC against 0x1B (CMP I,1B) — the poisoned-head colour that sends the head diving to the bottom of the screen.
CENTPC enters the head at VPOS 0xF8 (LDA I,0F8 / EOR CKF8 / STA MOBJV) — the top of the screen in upright mode (CKF8 = 0; the EOR is the cocktail vertical flip, dropped in the upright port).
CENTPC enters the head at HPOS 0x80 (LDA I,80 / STA MOBJH ;HPOS) — horizontal centre.
CENTPC spaces each body 8 pixels from the segment ahead: +8 when the copied heading is negative (LDA I,8), -8 when non-negative (LDA I,-8).
CENTPC seeds the first body picture at 2 (LDY I,2 / STY MOBJP ;BODY PICTURE) and alternates it, reloading to 7 on underflow (LDY I,7 ;ALTERNATE BODY SEGMENTS).
CENTPC's body-picture alternation reloads to 7 on underflow (LDY I,7 ;ALTERNATE BODY SEGMENTS).
CENTPC chooses the initial heading sign from RND0 bit 1 in normal play (LDA RND0 / AND I,2) — unlike Centipede, which reads FRAME. (Special attract mode forces a rightward start.)
The per-wave cadence runs only while CENTIS >= 3: CMP I,03 / BCC 5$ ;IF CENTIS < 3 skips the whole length/speed block below that speed.
When CENTIN decrements to zero the length reloads to 0x0C (LDA I,0C / STA CENTIN ;LONG CENTI AGAIN).
Millipede resets CENTIS to fast (2) only once SCORE2 >= 2 (i.e. after 20000): CPY I,2 / BCC 4$ ;ONLY FAST CENTIPEDES AFTER 20000 — Centipede's threshold is 4 (after 40000). Below it CENTIS is 1.
MOTION animates the legs every OTHER frame — LDA FRAME / AND I,1 / BNE 7$ ;SLOW DOWN LEGS gates the picture advance on FRAME bit 0.
The leg animation advances MOBJP by one and wraps it mod 8: ADC I,01 / AND I,7 / STA MOBJP ;MOVE LEGS.
MOTION does not speed up (or reverse) a segment that is mid-drop: 71$: AND I,07 / BNE 15$ ;DON'T SPEED UP IF TURNING — a segment off the 8px cell boundary (V&7 != 0) is still descending.
A BODY follows its leader down once the vertical gap reaches a full cell: (prev V) - (cur V), ABS, CMP I,08 / BCS 15$ ;DIFFERENCE=8 turns the body into the descent.
A head at the left screen edge is one whose HPOS >= 0xF0 (CMP I,0F0) — the edge that turns the head like a mushroom ahead.
A head at the right screen edge is one whose HPOS < 0x10 (11$: CMP I,10).
The vertical step subtracts MOBJDV from MOBJV (SBC X,MOBJDV / STA MOBJV ;CHANGE VPOS) — a positive MOBJDV DESCENDS (V decreases; V=0xF8 is the top).
The horizontal march adds MOBJDH to MOBJH every stepped frame (ADC X,MOBJH / STA MOBJH ;CHANGE HPOS), unconditionally — the coast-march, mid-drop included.
The horizontal direction reverses only when the new VPOS lands on cell-phase 4: AND I,07 / CMP I,04 / BNE 30$ ;NOT TIME TO CHANGE DIRECTION, then JSR COMP / STA MOBJDH ;CHANGE DIRECTION.
MOTION arms NEWD (start adding new heads) when a head reaches the bottom row (STY NEWD ;START ADDING NEW HEADS, Y=1).
NEWHD makes a fresh head's picture 0 (LDA I,0 / STA MOBJP ;MAKE HEAD PICTURE) — a plain head, distinct from CENTPC's 0x03.
NEWHD enters a fresh head at VPOS 0x40 (LDA I,40 / EOR CKF8 / STA MOBJV ;VPOS FOR NEW HEAD) — the player-zone entry row (CKF8 = 0 upright).
NEWHD's default entry side sets HPOS 0xFC and marches at MOBJDV 2 (LDA I,0FC / STA MOBJH ;HPOS FOR NEW HEAD; ORA I,2 / STA MOBJDV ;NEW CENTIPEDE GOES FAST).
NEWHD's mirror entry side (RND0 bit 1 clear) sets HPOS 0x04 and MOBJDH -2 (LDA I,4 / STA MOBJH; LDA I,-2 / STA MOBJDH). The default side keeps HPOS 0xFC with MOBJDH +2.
NEWHD ramps the head-spawn timer COUNT3 down by 8 each spawn until it floors at 0x60: CMP I,60 ;1 1/2 SECONDS / BCC 25$ ;SMALLEST VALUE WE ALLOW / SBC I,8.
NEWHD's COUNT3 floor is 0x60 (CMP I,60 ;1 1/2 SECONDS) — the smallest inter-spawn value the ramp allows.

MOTION speeds up the last surviving head only when exactly one segment is live: CMP Y,DEAD / BNE 78$ ;IF MORE THAN 1 LIVE SEGMENT skips the speed-up unless the live-segment count (DEAD, held per player) equals 1.
The last-head speed-up forces the per-frame step magnitude to 2 on both axes: LDA I,2 (a BPL sign test then chooses +2 or -2) followed by STA MOBJDH / STA MOBJDV ;SPEED UP LAST HEAD.

A motion object whose MOBJV (after EOR CKF8 for the cocktail flip) is >= 0xF4 is OFF THE TOP OF THE SCREEN — it is above the visible field. Read in the shot/object sweep: MOBJV is loaded, EOR CKF8, compared to 0xF4, and BCS branches to skip it "IF OFF TOP OF SCREEN" (MILLI.MAC:1869-1872). The wave-start train enters at ENTER_V=0xF8 (>= 0xF4), so the connected train is off the top by this rule; the render declines to paint it there (OFFTOP_V, segmentOnScreen).
